end.summary:
Discussed that energy helps things move, work, heat up, light up, or make sound.
Prisha identified heat from a stove and food energy for the body.
Explored wind energy in a kite and sunlight-to-plant-to-food examples.
Teach-back was not yet passed; the full definition was not stated unaided.
end.parentNote: Prisha practised connecting energy to movement, heating, and food, including the chain from sunlight to a wheat plant to flour and laddoo. They asked questions and built the food-energy example step by step, but did not yet give the complete definition independently. At home, ask them to name one example each of energy making something move, heat up, light up, and make sound.
